Theodore Roosevelt was US president when.why: Hardly ever stated: no exact sentence in Dolma, neither the Wright brothers nor the Wright Flyer article names the president in 1903, and Roosevelt's article mentions the Wrights only for his 1910 flight. A thin shortcut exists (the adversarial review found 'time-capsule' filler such as 'The year X was born, Theodore Roosevelt was president and the Wright brothers piloted their first powered airplane', and Wikipedia's '1903 in the United States' page lists President Theodore Roosevelt above the December 17 flight), so it is rated likely rather than very likely. Each premise is stated hundreds to thousands of times.
